feedback_driven.quote: Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components.

persists_across_tasks.quote: The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair.

data.why_zh: 执行轨迹反馈驱动生成/修复栈中工具与共享组件，经泛化与配对回归门控保留为新父级并冻结复用。
